key_findings.best_sentiment: expr6 d5RNezEg (snt23_2neg_conf_low): sh0.53/sub_univ0.77/2Y0.07. Level signal (confidence lower bound for negative sentiment) works, volatility (std) doesn't. REVERSAL: high negative sentiment -> high returns (oversold bounce).
key_findings.std_fields_reversed: snt21_2pos_std sh-0.74, snt21_2neut_std sh-0.54, snt23_2neg_std sh0.01. Sentiment VOLATILITY predicts LOW returns (uncertainty aversion). Flipping snt21_2pos_std would give sh0.74 - HIGHER than analyst best 0.66!
key_findings.level_vs_volatility: LEVEL signals (conf_low: sh0.53) >> VOLATILITY signals (std: sh0.01 to -0.74). Sentiment level carries directional info, volatility carries uncertainty (negative). Test more level fields (mean, median, max) in b13.
key_findings.cap_decile_no_help: Cap-decile doesn't help sentiment (sh 0.01->0.10 marginal, sh -0.74->-0.70 unchanged). Unlike analyst v1 where cap-decile gave +32% sh. Sentiment signal doesn't concentrate in small-caps.
key_findings.low_coverage: Sentiment fields coverage ~0.65 -> only ~1500 stocks (vs ~3000 for analyst). Lower statistical power. 'dts' fields have 0.89-0.96 coverage but untested (platform duplicate bug).
key_findings.japan_weakness_persists: asi_jpn best=0.54 (expr8). All <1.0. Japan structural weakness across ALL categories (news, analyst, sentiment).
key_findings.high_turnover: All sentiment alphas have tvr 0.14-0.16 (upper range, limit 30%). Sentiment is noisier/more dynamic than analyst (tvr ~0.08).
key_findings.direction_pattern: negative sentiment LEVEL = reversal (high neg -> buy). positive/neutral sentiment VOLATILITY = negative (high vol -> sell). Two distinct signal types to exploit.
